|game_text=Deploy on Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique (•) combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3, the current text (version 4 of 4): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, official text as of 27 April 2013. It repeats word for word the text of [[Frostbite (V)]] (the original). It is the last publication of this card, so it is current; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image here is the Master List slip.
* '''Original''' ([[Frostbite (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique (•) combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 123. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-123-Frostbite.png]]) prints slip number “123” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Frostbite (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Deploy on Hoth system” to “Deploy on the Hoth system” (“immune to Alter.” is the card list's spelling of the Immune to Alter icon). PC-E1 text: “Deploy on the Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique () combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, immune to Alter.”<ref name="cl-1220_123">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Frostbite (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-frostbite-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual2-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/frostbite.gif</code>; the Internet Archive capture of that folder's directory listing ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034559/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual2-Light], 18 August 2019) gives every file the date 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34 (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock2-Light/large/frostbite.gif</ref>: “Deploy on Hoth system if you control two exterior Hoth sites. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force for each Hoth site you control with a unique (•) combat vehicle. If opponent controls this system, this Effect lost. While you occupy 1st marker, [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 2 set mark) and prints the number “123” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
